Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.constants

Class SwerveConstants

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.constants.SwerveConstants
public class SwerveConstants extends Object
Top-level, builder-style configuration for a swerve drivetrain: physical chassis dimensions, speed and acceleration limits, module/motor configuration, gyro selection, simulation-only parameters, and miscellaneous options, grouped into nested holder classes. Each withX method sets the corresponding group and returns this for chaining.
